text: Scarcely had they drunk the water. <break time="0.8s" /> When a sudden glow of cheerful sunshine. <break time="0.8s" /> Seemed to brighten their faces. <break time="0.8s" /> And the deep furrows of age. <break time="0.8s" /> Began to fade away. <break time="0.8s" /> Give us more of this wondrous water. <break time="0.8s" /> They cried eagerly. <break time="0.8s" /> And with every glass. <break time="0.8s" /> The years seemed to roll back. <break time="0.8s" /> Like a dream from which they were waking. <break time="0.8s" /> Mister Gascoignes mind. <break time="0.8s" /> Seemed to run on political topics. <break time="0.8s" /> And he talked in a deep, important voice. <break time="0.8s" /> About patriotism and national glory. <break time="0.8s" /> Though nobody could tell. <break time="0.8s" /> What he really meant. <break time="0.8s" /> Colonel Killigrew began to sing. <break time="0.8s" /> A merry drinking song. <break time="0.8s" /> While Mister Medbourne was busy calculating. <break time="0.8s" /> A plan for supplying the East Indies with ice. <break time="0.8s" /> By harnessing whales. <break time="0.8s" /> To the polar icebergs. <break time="0.8s" /> As for the Widow Wycherly. <break time="0.8s" /> She stood before the mirror. <break time="0.8s" /> Curtsying and simpering. <break time="0.8s" /> To her own image. <break time="0.8s" /> And greeting it as the friend. <break time="0.8s" /> She loved better than all the world. <break time="0.8s" /> Soon the three gentlemen. <break time="0.8s" /> Began to compete for her favor. <break time="0.8s" /> Each trying to snatch her hand. <break time="0.8s" /> And their old rivalry. <break time="0.8s" /> Burst into flame. <break time="0.8s" /> As if not a single day had passed. <break time="0.8s" /> In the struggle. <break time="0.8s" /> The table was overturned. <break time="0.8s" /> And the precious vase. <break time="0.8s" /> Was dashed into a thousand fragments. <break time="0.8s" /> While the Water of Youth. <break time="0.8s" /> Flowed in a bright stream. <break time="0.8s" /> Across the floor. <break time="0.8s" /> A butterfly. <break time="0.8s" /> Which had grown old. <break time="0.8s" /> And was ready to die. <break time="0.8s" /> Alighted on the snowy head. <break time="0.8s" /> Of Doctor Heidegger. <break time="0.8s" /> After it had been touched by a few drops.
